required: completed file exists and its SHA-256 matches
Review ID, A, and B are exact by released-packet row
exactly 180 scores are present and allowed
no review row or instruction content changed

score_meanings.3: A and B have about the same specificity
score_meanings.X: No usable meaning comparison could be derived and specificity did not matter

annotation_protocol.user_rule_caveat: Score 3 was used whenever specificity was judged the same, even if wording introduced a subtle meaning difference or alternative interpretation. X was reserved for cases where no meaning could be derived and specificity did not matter. A small number of rows may have this score-3 caveat. Scores are not recoded post hoc.
annotation_protocol.claim_boundary: A direction-valid result is specificity agreement under the user's operational rule, not proof that an edit fully preserves semantics, factuality, or communicative intent.
annotation_protocol.tracked_examples: Do not quote review sentences in compact tracked evidence; describe the narrow same-specificity/subtle-semantic-shift caveat conceptually.

orientation.score_3_sensitivity_rule: Score 3 is non-success for add_specific and de_specify and success only for irrelevant_rewrite. Report score-3 prevalence separately; do not infer semantic preservation from it.
orientation.x_handling: X is a failure in all-case direction-validity rates, excluded from ordinal utilities and correlations, and reported separately as an X rate.

analysis_sets.transformations: No rescaling, recentering, calibration, or post hoc correction. Earlier scores remain unchanged absent a documented clerical error; none is reported.

policies.consensus_inclusion_reason: The rank-consensus policy was frozen before ratings in round2_human_first_reranking_v1.
estimands: selected-candidate direction-validity rate with X counted as failure
comparable-only mean direction-aligned ordinal utility with denominator
paired percentage-point difference in direction-validity versus unguided
paired ordinal win/loss/tie versus unguided on mutually comparable selections
policies.drift_sensitivity_pairing: After excluding early review positions, a guided-versus-unguided contrast retains a source case only when both selected rows survive; report paired case count for every contrast.

candidate_level_predictor_agreement.estimand: Spearman correlation of specificity-aligned candidate-minus-original metric delta with human candidate_delta among non-X rows
candidate_level_predictor_agreement.interpretation: association with one evaluator's operational specificity judgment, not accuracy or truth

automatic_proxy_comparison.x_rule: X is human negative in the primary confusion table and is also reported as a separate component.

uncertainty.overall_resampling: resample source cases within frozen corpus-by-edit_type cells and concatenate strata
uncertainty.subset_resampling: resample source cases within the displayed subset; reuse identical draws across policies/models in each paired contrast
uncertainty.small_or_degenerate_strata: report point estimate, denominator, and an unavailable or degenerate interval transparently

outputs.privacy: Tracked artifacts contain only aggregate counts/statistics, stable method labels, hashes, and provenance. They contain no sentence text, review IDs, source/candidate IDs, selector mappings, or row-level human outcomes.

reporting.one_evaluator_boundary: Do not claim accuracy, truth, gold-standard validity, or general human preference from one evaluator.
reporting.independence_boundary: The 180 judgments are three candidates for each of 60 source cases, not 180 independent sources.
reporting.next_gate: No manuscript integration without separate primary review and authorization.
